center: Full-coordinate empirical mean via dimension-wise ordered FP64 additions in ascending row-ID order;choose real member with minimum ordered FP64 squared distance to that mean,tie smallest row ID. Same rule for every builder and node;not an exact medoid.

certificate.center_coordinates: Gather from original database;charge full D*4 per visited node in coordinate proxy;no free center or verifier reuse
certificate.family: One real-member center and conservative covering radius per node,triangle-inequality range rejection
certificate.guard: Reuse interval/radius_upper from block_certificate_headroom_20261010/run.py and ball_keep from block_local_ball_20261011/ball.py;R=max upper endpoint over every member;reject only query-center lower>nextup(R+r_upper);equality retained
certificate.score: Reuse unchanged ordered pair kernel from block_local_ball_20261011/pairs.cpp;no fast math or contraction

evaluation.all_node_checks: Every query x8191 nodes:zero rejected nodes containing any authoritative hit
evaluation.distance_contrast: Old query full-reference distance p10,p50,p90 and (p90-p10)/p50,plus hit count;not an intrinsic-dimension estimator
evaluation.flat_leaf_diagnostic: Also compare all leaf certificates with leaf oracle without hierarchy;separate this from actual tree traversal
evaluation.levels: Each depth0..12 covers N points;report node counts and object-mass-weighted oracle/certificate rejection,certificate capture and gaps;do not confuse node fraction with object saving
evaluation.oracle: d_min=min authoritative ordered FP64 score over all node members;oracle may reject iff d_min>r_squared.It is a diagnostic,not a realizable access method.
evaluation.point_checks: Verify every true-hit ID remains in retained leaves;distance fields are not generated by a deployed query engine
evaluation.source_proxy: coordinate bytes=(visited_nodes+retained_leaf_points)*D*4+query D*4;metadata reads=visited_nodes*32;extra ID-map/output/state/cache traffic is separate/unmeasured.No physical DRAM or Host-ready timing claim.
evaluation.traversal: Depth-first root-first;only visit children if parent ball retained;remaining points are union of retained leaves;no double-counting ancestor/descendant pruning

hypotheses.negative: Even geometry-aware partitions may retain many points or fail to yield savings after center-distance and control costs;negative scope is this family and snapshot,not all high-dimensional trees.
hypotheses.positive: At fixed shape and certificate budget,query-independent partitioning may increase oracle-rejectable object mass,improve bound capture,or both.

novelty: NOT_ADMITTED:classical balanced partitioning,coordinate/PCA splits and metric-ball bounds.This is mechanism discrimination,not a new tree index contribution.
preservation: Read-only original data and references;new task-owned outputs only;do not read the frozen128 heldout query payload or derive any of their query-specific features. X remains the common database,not a heldout query input.
prior_negative: S1/P2 single-ball test retained92.2501%/93.4250% blocks under signature-mean centers. This experiment does not erase it or revive a novel single-ball thesis;it tests different controlled partitions with a shared full-coordinate center rule.
scope: CPU-only initial-snapshot fixed-development-query geometric diagnosis;no index novelty,GPU,update,heldout or end-to-end admission

statistics.aggregate: Arithmetic means and median/p10/p90/min/max across32;every builder and every per-query row retained;no posthoc winner used for promotion
statistics.causality: Same D and dataset isolate tested construction choices,not causal effect of dimension. Changing several partition rules is not evidence one rule is universally optimal.
statistics.decision: Descriptive diagnosis only. Any false prune,input/source/hash/coverage failure -> INVALID_STOP. Otherwise report continuous partition opportunity,bound slack and charged proxy. No GO for GPU or BQSI.
statistics.population: All original32 queries,all N points,all nodes;no query selection,no confidence intervals from deterministic structural counts

tree.kd: At each node,full-coordinate min/max;choose maximal span,tie lowest dimension;sort by (coordinate,immutable row ID),then median
tree.pca: At each node,take min(512,node_size) members with smallest global random rank,then sort sample IDs ascending;center by the complete-node empirical mean;initialize direction at maximal sample centered sum-of-squares coordinate,tie lowest;8 fixed power iterations Y.T@(Y@v),normalize each;zero norm retains prior direction;project all node members,sort by (projection,row ID),median. This is a sampled fixed-iteration PCA-inspired splitter,not an exact PCA eigensolver.
tree.query_blind: Builders receive only X,immutable IDs,and seed;no query IDs,radii,reference distances,rejection outcomes or heldout recipe/signature
tree.random: NumPy PCG64(seed).permutation(N);global rank defines split order and all PCA samples;independent of queries and scores
tree.split: Exactly floor(n/2) versus remaining at each internal node;fixed full binary topology;heap indexing;no split threshold tuning
